responsibility: Implements C++ constexpr and constant-expression analysis and evaluation. It records constexpr function bodies, checks literal-type and constexpr-object rules, diagnoses invalid constexpr constructs, determines whether expressions are potential or immediate constant expressions under the current dialect, and performs the front end's AST-level constant evaluation used by parsing, template instantiation, static initialization checks, and constexpr-specific diagnostics. Its core responsibilities include the constant-evaluation dispatcher, constexpr call evaluation and parameter binding, object/store/lvalue handling, array/member/indirect reference evaluation, loop and initializer evaluation, and explaining why a construct is not a valid constant expression.
